projects.title: CycloneWatch AI
projects.tagline: Disaster Response Copilot & Real-Time Geospatial Triage
projects.description: Multimodal cyclone damage assessment and first-responder triage engine tailored for coastal emergency corridors. Processes live field damage imagery with Gemma 4 vision to extract incident severity, auto-extracts GPS EXIF metadata with fallback coastal geo-bounding, and streams real-time GeoJSON hazard overlays for command centers.
highlights: GPS EXIF parsing with Odisha coastal geo-bounding
